### Cauchy-Schwartz Inequality

:::{.theorem data-title="Cauchy-Schwartz Inequality"}

The **Cauchy-Schwartz inequality** is derived directly from [[holders-inequality]] with values $Y=1$ and $p=2$ and specifically states $$\mathbb{E}|X|\leq (\mathbb{E}|X|^2)^{1/2}.$$

:::
